Package org.aristonis.diwan.database.android

Class AndroidConnector

java.lang.Object
org.aristonis.diwan.database.android.AndroidConnector
All Implemented Interfaces:
Connector
public final class AndroidConnector extends Object implements Connector
The Connector for Android's SQLite, driver name android.

An Android database needs a Context, which no configuration file can hold, so the connector is built in code from a supplier of the application's SQLiteOpenHelper. The supplier runs when the connection is first built, not before, because opening the database runs the helper's onCreate or onUpgrade; build the first connection off the main thread. The url, host and database settings are ignored, and so is a supplied DataSource; the helper decides where the database lives.

The transaction_mode option chooses how a transaction begins. Unset or exclusive (any case) uses beginTransaction(), as before; immediate uses beginTransactionNonExclusive(), which takes the write lock at the start. deferred is refused, because Android cannot begin a deferred transaction, and so is any other value. In write-ahead-logging mode immediate and exclusive behave alike, since readers do not block the writer.

The lock_wait option, such as 5s or 500ms, sets PRAGMA busy_timeout once the database opens, so every statement waits that long for a lock before it fails.

Queries and schema use the SQLite grammars, which of(Supplier, Function, Function) takes explicitly: AndroidConnector.of(() -> helper, SQLiteQuery::of, SQLiteSchema::of).

Instances are safe to share across threads and across connection names.

      public static AndroidConnector of(Supplier<? extends android.database.sqlite.SQLiteOpenHelper> helper, Function<Connection,QueryFactory> queryFactory, Function<Connection,Schema> schemaFactory)
      Creates a connector with explicit query and schema factories, for example AndroidConnector.of(() -> helper, SQLiteQuery::of, SQLiteSchema::of).
      Parameters:
      helper - the supplier of the application's helper, never null; called once per connection built, off the main thread
      queryFactory - builds the query factory of a connection, for example SQLiteQuery::of, never null
      schemaFactory - builds the schema of a connection, for example SQLiteSchema::of, never null
      Returns:
      the connector, never null
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if an argument is null

    • connect

      public Connection connect(ConnectionConfig config, DataSource dataSource)
      Builds a connection for a config.

      When the connector needs a resource that outlives the call, such as the anchor connection that keeps an in-memory database alive, it keeps the resource and releases it in Connector.close(Connection).

      Specified by:
      connect in interface Connector
      Parameters:
      config - the connection config, never null
      dataSource - the data source the user registered for this connection, or null when the connector must build its own from the config
      Returns:
      the connection, never null
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if the helper supplier returns null
      DatabaseConfigException - if transaction_mode is deferred or is not immediate or exclusive, or if lock_wait is not a positive duration
